subject: info-dy
title: INFO.DY.------C.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 81 ((AF)D-9). INFO-DY (information dynamics) is the subject; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. From the subject: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: IST-FT (isolated focus), INFO-PROJ (information projection) and ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism). From INFO-PROJ: MT-INFO (multi-information). PROG-EXT-F (progressional extended functionalism) is on a dotted line from INFO-PROJ. From ALT-C-PG: SOC-RT-INT (social reality interpretation). From PROG-EXT-F: STF (source transfer), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
